journal.title: 暗礁破笼
journal.clue: 龙蛋遇见月光，响起与牢门相同的三声低鸣。囚衣里的时光牌写着“五秒”，你不记得是谁给的。
journal.clueEn: Under moonlight the egg hums the same three low notes as the cell doors. Inside your prison shirt sits a time card that reads “five seconds” — you do not remember who gave it to you.

journal.clueEn: The ink on all three warrants fades in the same instant.

journal.clue: 龙蛋遇见月光，响起与牢门相同的三声低鸣。囚衣里的时光牌写着“五秒”，你不记得是谁给的。

journal.title: 离岸之夜
journal.clue: 名单上的“逃犯”，原本写的是“容器”。
journal.clueEn: Where the list reads “fugitive”, it once read “vessel”.

journal.title: 三岔口的灯
journal.clue: 你选择了追猎。流言的尽头是一枚月纹——代价由下一战的路先付。
journal.clueEn: You chose pursuit. The rumor ends at a moon-mark — the next road pays its toll first.

journal.title: 山的重量
journal.clue: 第一份材料不是战利品，而是一个要归还的约定。
journal.clueEn: The first ingredient is not spoils but a promise that must be returned.

journal.title: 蛛丝上的名字
journal.clue: 监狱关押的，从来不只是罪犯。
journal.clueEn: The prison never held only criminals.

journal.title: 深海旧誓
journal.clue: 解锁锻造：小鱼人每战携带攻击 +2 的潮汐刃；能量转移返还 2 魔力。
journal.clueEn: Forge unlocked: Slark carries a +2 tide blade into every battle; Essence Shift refunds 2 mana.

journal.title: 偷走刀的人
journal.titleEn: The Man Who Stole the Knife
journal.clue: 偷刀的人没有隐藏证据，反而逼你亲眼看见。
journal.clueEn: The thief hid no evidence — he forced you to see it with your own eyes.

journal.title: 导师的空座
journal.clue: 获得一次性的神杖。最好留给真正需要它的人。
journal.clueEn: You gain the one-use Scepter. Save it for whoever truly needs it.

journal.title: 折镜里的捷径
journal.clue: 镜子收走的热度，在档案库的月光里才慢慢回来。
journal.clueEn: The warmth the mirrors took only returns under the archive moonlight.

journal.title: 金钥匙没有锁
journal.clue: 潜入规则：队伍不自动攻击；每轮获得无声通行。攻击牌增加警戒，达到 2 即失败；前庭哨位上，当轮未倒的守卫会立刻拉响警报。
journal.clueEn: Infiltration rules: the party never attacks on its own; gain a Silent Passage each round. Attack cards raise the alarm — at 2 you fail; on the gallery watch, any guard alive at round’s end sounds it instantly.

journal.title: 诗中尚有春天
journal.titleEn: Spring Still Lives in the Poem
journal.clue: “归还三物，容器归位。”这不是赃物清单，是祭仪。龙裔盟誓已加入你的牌组。
journal.clueEn: “Return the three things, and the vessel is restored.” This is no list of loot — it is a rite. Wyrmkin Oath has joined your deck.

journal.title: 不熄的借火
journal.clue: 火种照出印章主人的脸：泽特的残影，而非泽特本身。
journal.clueEn: The flame reveals the seal-owner’s face: Zet’s remnant, not Zet himself.

journal.title: 赊来的火
journal.clue: 火种在你掌心记账。它不催，只是越来越沉。
journal.clueEn: The ember keeps its ledger in your palm. It never presses — only grows heavier.

journal.clue: 你选择了追猎。流言的尽头是一枚月纹——代价由下一战的路先付。
journal.clueEn: You chose pursuit. The rumor ends at a moon-mark — the next road pays its toll first.

journal.title: 山的重量
journal.clue: 第一份材料不是战利品，而是一个要归还的约定。
journal.clueEn: The first ingredient is not spoils but a promise that must be returned.

journal.title: 蛛丝上的名字
journal.clue: 监狱关押的，从来不只是罪犯。
journal.clueEn: The prison never held only criminals.

journal.title: 深海旧誓
journal.clue: 解锁锻造：小鱼人每战携带攻击 +2 的潮汐刃；能量转移返还 2 魔力。
journal.clueEn: Forge unlocked: Slark carries a +2 tide blade into every battle; Essence Shift refunds 2 mana.

journal.title: 偷走刀的人
journal.titleEn: The Man Who Stole the Knife
journal.clue: 偷刀的人没有隐藏证据，反而逼你亲眼看见。
journal.clueEn: The thief hid no evidence — he forced you to see it with your own eyes.

journal.title: 导师的空座
journal.clue: 获得一次性的神杖。最好留给真正需要它的人。
journal.clueEn: You gain the one-use Scepter. Save it for whoever truly needs it.

journal.title: 折镜里的捷径
journal.clue: 镜子收走的热度，在档案库的月光里才慢慢回来。
journal.clueEn: The warmth the mirrors took only returns under the archive moonlight.

journal.title: 金钥匙没有锁
journal.clue: 潜入规则：队伍不自动攻击；每轮获得无声通行。攻击牌增加警戒，达到 2 即失败；前庭哨位上，当轮未倒的守卫会立刻拉响警报。
journal.clueEn: Infiltration rules: the party never attacks on its own; gain a Silent Passage each round. Attack cards raise the alarm — at 2 you fail; on the gallery watch, any guard alive at round’s end sounds it instantly.

journal.title: 诗中尚有春天
journal.titleEn: Spring Still Lives in the Poem
journal.clue: “归还三物，容器归位。”这不是赃物清单，是祭仪。龙裔盟誓已加入你的牌组。
journal.clueEn: “Return the three things, and the vessel is restored.” This is no list of loot — it is a rite. Wyrmkin Oath has joined your deck.

journal.title: 不熄的借火
journal.clue: 火种照出印章主人的脸：泽特的残影，而非泽特本身。
journal.clueEn: The flame reveals the seal-owner’s face: Zet’s remnant, not Zet himself.

journal.title: 赊来的火
journal.clue: 火种在你掌心记账。它不催，只是越来越沉。
journal.clueEn: The ember keeps its ledger in your palm. It never presses — only grows heavier.

journal.title: 五秒以前
journal.clue: 必须施放时光倒流，才能击破时间茧。
journal.clueEn: You must cast Rewind before the cocoon can be broken.

journal.title: 暗礁仰望天空
journal.clue: 下一战开始，共鸣带来的攻击与额外成长将被抽离。
journal.clueEn: From the next battle onward, the attack that resonance granted will be drawn out of you.

journal.title: 空手的人
journal.clue: 被决裂的队友会在终战作为残月幻影出现。
journal.clueEn: Companions you severed will return as waning phantoms in the last battles.

journal.title: 最后一桶火油
journal.clue: 火光照亮了同行的人，也照亮了桥上等着你的名单。
journal.clueEn: The fire lit the ones beside you — and lit the list waiting on the bridge.

journal.title: 暗礁破笼

journal.title: 三罪追缉

journal.clueEn: The ink on all three warrants fades in the same instant.

journal.title: 灯火不退
journal.clue: 灯塔的老钟，与龙蛋的心跳同频。
journal.clueEn: The lighthouse’s old bell beats in time with the dragon egg’s heart.

journal.title: 折断的月角
journal.clue: 月石裂口流出银光，逆着风飘向北方。
journal.clueEn: Silver light leaks from the stone’s crack and drifts north against the wind.

journal.clue: 潜入规则：队伍不自动攻击；每轮获得无声通行。攻击牌增加警戒，达到 2 即失败；前庭哨位上，当轮未倒的守卫会立刻拉响警报。
journal.clueEn: Infiltration rules: the party never attacks on its own; gain a Silent Passage each round. Attack cards raise the alarm — at 2 you fail; on the gallery watch, any guard alive at round’s end sounds it instantly.

journal.title: 诗中尚有春天
journal.titleEn: Spring Still Lives in the Poem
journal.clue: “归还三物，容器归位。”这不是赃物清单，是祭仪。龙裔盟誓已加入你的牌组。
journal.clueEn: “Return the three things, and the vessel is restored.” This is no list of loot — it is a rite. Wyrmkin Oath has joined your deck.

journal.title: 不熄的借火
journal.clue: 火种照出印章主人的脸：泽特的残影，而非泽特本身。
journal.clueEn: The flame reveals the seal-owner’s face: Zet’s remnant, not Zet himself.

journal.title: 赊来的火
journal.clue: 火种在你掌心记账。它不催，只是越来越沉。
journal.clueEn: The ember keeps its ledger in your palm. It never presses — only grows heavier.

journal.title: 五秒以前
journal.clue: 必须施放时光倒流，才能击破时间茧。
journal.clueEn: You must cast Rewind before the cocoon can be broken.

journal.title: 暗礁仰望天空
journal.clue: 下一战开始，共鸣带来的攻击与额外成长将被抽离。
journal.clueEn: From the next battle onward, the attack that resonance granted will be drawn out of you.

journal.title: 空手的人
journal.clue: 被决裂的队友会在终战作为残月幻影出现。
journal.clueEn: Companions you severed will return as waning phantoms in the last battles.

journal.title: 最后一桶火油
journal.clue: 火光照亮了同行的人，也照亮了桥上等着你的名单。
journal.clueEn: The fire lit the ones beside you — and lit the list waiting on the bridge.

journal.title: 被留下的名字
journal.clue: 亲密队友的约定牌，会在最后一战保留全部力量。
journal.clueEn: The vow cards of close companions keep their full strength in the final battle.

journal.title: 自由的潮汐
journal.clue: 全队阵亡或回合耗尽即失败。击败残月回声与所有幻影，结束旅程。
journal.clueEn: A party wipe or an exhausted clock means defeat. Defeat the Waning Echo and every phantom to end the journey.
